name: ebook-monorepo
description: FlipBook Interactive E-Book Platform Monorepo • Politeknik Besut

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});} fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','dist',{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('backend/public')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','backend/public',{recursive:true});}"
